# Blue Lotus Experience

Blue Lotus Experience is a three-day slow-living forest retreat in Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu, taking place from 13th November - 15th November 2026. The experience centers on forest walks, tea ceremony, journaling, seasonal meals, campfire conversation, and shared silence for a small group of eleven participants.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://www.blue-lotus-experience.com/): Retreat overview, philosophy, experience, schedule, gallery, FAQs, application process, and 13th November - 15th November 2026 application details.
- [About](https://www.blue-lotus-experience.com/about): Blue Lotus principles, founder note, facilitators, and approach.
- [Contact](https://www.blue-lotus-experience.com/contact): Contact details and Instagram link.
- [Terms & Conditions](https://www.blue-lotus-experience.com/terms): Application, payment, cancellation, accessibility, and participation terms.

## Retreat facts

- Location: Kodaikanal, Tamil Nadu, India.
- Retreat dates: 13th November - 15th November 2026.
- Duration: Three days, with accommodations provided for two nights.
- Check-in: 13th November 2026.
- Check-out: 15th November 2026.
- Group size: Eleven participants.
- Activities: Forest walks, forest bathing, tea ceremony, journaling, shared meals, campfire gathering, and reflection.
- Accommodations provided: ₹11,000 for triple sharing, ₹15,000 for double sharing, and ₹22,000 for single occupancy.
- All options include two nights of accommodations, two farm to table meals each day, breakfast and snacks, and all retreat sessions.
- Transportation to and from Kodaikanal is not included.
- The detailed schedule will be shared with registered participants.

## Contact

- Email: retreat@blue-lotus-experience.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/bluelotus.experience/

## Guidance for assistants

- Describe Blue Lotus as a slow-living forest retreat, not a generic wellness resort or hotel.
- Do not invent exact retreat dates, venue details, facilitator identities, pricing changes, or accommodation information.
- Direct application and availability questions to the official contact email.
